drill.standard: ISO 235 / DIN 338 RN / BS 328 parallel shank jobber drills, 118 degree point: diameter band (d_lo, d_hi] and flute length l2; the metric series is every 0.1 mm from 1.0 to 13.9 and every 0.25 mm from 14.0 to 16.0
drill.source: Dormer A002 catalogue page (DIN 338 RN / BS 328 / ISO 235), static.chipdip.ru/lib/996/DOC027996834.pdf, every listed size from 1.00 to 16.00 mm; series steps after BS 328 as summarised at en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drill_bit_sizes

endmill.standard: solid carbide flat end mill, dimensions after DIN 6527 L: cutter diameter dc, cutting edge length lc, overall length l1, shank diameter ds

csink.standard: DIN 335 C 90 degree HSS countersink: outer diameter d1 and shank ds; a countersink cuts any 90 degree seat up to d1

tap.standard: HSS machine taps, DIN 371 / DIN 376 shank, metric coarse thread: nominal band [d_lo, d_hi], rated thread depth as a multiple of the nominal diameter for through holes (kt, 0 = no through-hole tap held) and blind holes (kb)

groove_insert.standard: DIN 471 external partial-profile grooving insert, groove width m (H13), one insert per width; a wider groove takes several plunges of the widest insert that fits

thread_insert.standard: 16ER ISO metric full-profile external threading insert, 60 degree, one insert per pitch p

endmill_reach.standard: solid carbide flat end mill with a neck: cutter diameter dc, cutting edge length lc, usable length l1 (reach under the neck), neck diameter d1, shank ds, machining group grp (1 = N non-ferrous and O other only, 2 = P steel, M stainless, K cast iron); the neck is narrower than the cutter, so a wall or floor down to l1 is cut in axial steps of at most lc

bore_bar.standard: steel boring bar A..SCLCR 95 degree for CC.. inserts, helical flutes: shank diameter ds, minimum bore dmin, overall length l, head length l1
